title: Coverage A and Coverage C Limits by CondoGuard Tier
content:
Limits schedule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy. Coverage A (the unit's fixtures, improvements and betterments) has a minimum that depends on the type of master policy the association carries, and a maximum; Coverage C (personal property) has a minimum and a maximum; Coverage D (loss of use) is a percent of Coverage C.

## Coverage A minimum by master policy type, and Coverage A maximum (USD)

| Tier | Minimum, bare walls master policy | Minimum, single entity master policy | Minimum, all-in master policy | Maximum Coverage A |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 50000 | 20000 | 5000 | 150000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 60000 | 25000 | 10000 | 200000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 60000 | 25000 | 10000 | 250000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 75000 | 30000 | 15000 | 300000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 100000 | 40000 | 20000 | 400000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 150000 | 60000 | 30000 | 750000 |

Each tier has three Coverage A minimums, one for each master policy type: the bare-walls minimum when the association's master policy is bare walls, the single-entity minimum when it is single entity, and the all-in minimum when it is all-in.

## Coverage C range and Coverage D (loss of use)

| Tier | Minimum Coverage C (USD) | Maximum Coverage C (USD) | Coverage D, percent of Coverage C |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 15000 | 60000 | 40 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 20000 | 80000 | 40 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 25000 | 100000 | 50 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 30000 | 125000 | 50 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 40000 | 175000 | 50 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 60000 | 300000 | 50 |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced unit whose association carries a single entity master policy has a Coverage A minimum of 30000 USD; if the same association carried a bare walls master policy the minimum would be 75000 USD, and under an all-in master policy 15000 USD.
- A CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential policy with Coverage C of 40000 USD carries Coverage D of 50 percent of that amount, that is 20000 USD.
- On CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential a Coverage C of 60000 USD sits exactly at the maximum and is within the range; 60500 USD is above it.
